### Inference

Support level: Insufficient evidence

The evidence is insufficient to infer a structural change in the process. Only one indicator passed the screening threshold, while about 0.45 such items are expected by chance alone in an unchanged process; a single item of this size is typical of random variation. [POS001, screening]
